title: Austin: Land Deals, Engineer Hired, Taxes Waived
summary:
*   **Land Decisions:** Rejected a significant $8,500 offer to purchase 20 acres of land located near the Colorado River, while separately approving the purchase of a smaller 30x69 foot city plot for $600.
*   **Infrastructure & Staffing:** Authorized a $700 project to modify a sidewalk section on 8th Street and appointed Julian Montgomery as the 4th Assistant City Engineer.
*   **Taxpayer Relief:** Approved a unique request to waive interest and penalties on a citizen's cemetery taxes, acknowledging an "honest mistake" made regarding property sale funds.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution: Resolved by the City Council

Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council
of the City of Austin : That inasmuch as there was an honest mistake on the part of V O
Weed, as to how the sum of $ 434.00, arising from the sale of a certain piece of property
to the City of Austin for cemetery taxes, should be applied on the payment of his taxes.
Now, therefore, Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That the Assessor &
Collector of taxes of the City of Austin, Texas, in settling with the said V O Weed for
taxes due on 120 feet across the south part of lots 9 & 12, in block 2 Outlot 11 Div "Z",
of the City of Austin, Texas, shall charge neither interest nor penalties against said
property beyond the 9th day of January 1914, provided that promptly upon the passage of
this resolution, all taxes owning by the said V O Weedare paid in full.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
